title: What Happens If You Travel Near Light Speed?

actions.reason: no public thumbnail or trailer URL

input.text:
One year on your watch. Seven years pass at home.

Leave Earth at ninety-nine percent of the speed of light for one year by your own watch, and seven years pass at home. What happens if you travel near the speed of light? That gap is time dilation, and special relativity says nobody cheated: a moving clock really runs slow.

Would you take a trip that costs you seven years at home for one of yours?

#LightSpeedTravel #NearLightSpeed #Relativity
